1.summary: Earn the other 54 single-player trophies, including the completion checklist and the separate character questlines. PowerPyx estimates a single playthrough, with the Chapter 1 meditation needing early attention.
1.when: Across the playthrough, then post-story cleanup
prerequisites: Earn all other 54 trophies

steps.text: Keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter. PowerPyx reports 15 manual slots and no mission replay, and flags the Jason-house meditation during Chapter 1.
Finish the story while scanning new base-model vehicles and studying animals. Complete optional tasks as they appear to reduce the later checklist work.
After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and finish its requirements. These include 300 stunts, 70 challenges and 15 card sets, exceeding the corresponding standalone trophies.
Finish remaining stranger strands and miscellaneous trophies in free roam, then check the trophy list for the last missing unlocks. The platinum requires the single-player list only.

missable.note: The platinum depends on Positive Mental Attitude. PowerPyx has not confirmed whether its Chapter 1-only meditation is mandatory.

1.effort: PowerPyx estimates about 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty for the full platinum.

2.summary: Finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. The trophy is an automatic story milestone.

steps.text: Create a manual save near the start of Chapter 1 if you want a return point. The roadmap recommends chapter-boundary saves because missions have no replay option.
Follow the main story through Gone Fishing. Completing this first Chapter 1 mission awards the trophy automatically.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly identifies Gone Fishing as an automatic, unmissable story unlock.

3.summary: Advance into Chapter 2 and finish What’s in the Bag? to receive the Chapter 1 milestone. PowerPyx places the unlock at the opening mission of the next chapter.
3.when: Chapter 2, after What’s in the Bag?
prerequisites: Progress through Chapter 1

steps.text: Before leaving Chapter 1, keep a manual save and attend to Lucia’s morning meditation invitation at Jason’s house. The roadmap flags that separate trophy opportunity as Chapter 1-only.
Continue the story into Chapter 2 and complete its first main mission, What’s in the Bag?. PowerPyx says this automatically awards Paradise Lost.

missable.note: PowerPyx marks this chapter milestone as automatic and unmissable. The meditation warning concerns a separate trophy.

4.summary: Play through Chapter 2, then finish Welcome to Vice City at the start of Chapter 3. That mission is the reported trigger for this chapter-completion trophy.
4.when: Chapter 3, after Welcome to Vice City
prerequisites: Progress through Chapter 2

steps.text: Keep a manual save at the Chapter 2 boundary. PowerPyx recommends retaining the start and end of each chapter because there is no mission replay.
Complete Welcome to Vice City, Chapter 3’s first main mission. The Chapter 2 trophy unlocks automatically at that point according to the trophy paragraph.

missable.note: PowerPyx lists this as an automatic story trophy that cannot be missed.

5.summary: Finish the opening pair of Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. PowerPyx associates this pair with the Chapter 3 completion trophy.
5.when: Chapter 4, after Ocean Beach and Another Life
prerequisites: Progress through Chapter 3

steps.text: Retain a Chapter 3 end save before continuing. The roadmap recommends chapter-boundary backups because completed missions cannot be replayed.
Complete both Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4. PowerPyx reports an automatic trophy after these two main missions.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly marks this as an automatic, unmissable story milestone.

6.summary: Complete Chapter 4 through the main story. PowerPyx names Starting From Zero as the trigger, but its chapter and final-mission entries conflict, leaving the precise placement unconfirmed.
6.when: Chapter 4 completion, exact mission placement unconfirmed
prerequisites: Progress through the Chapter 4 main story

steps.text: Keep a manual save at the start and end of Chapter 4, following the roadmap’s save advice for a game without mission replay.
Continue through the Chapter 4 main missions. The official trophy description requires finishing Chapter 4.

Watch for the automatic unlock around Starting From Zero. PowerPyx assigns it to both this trophy and the final-mission trophy while also listing a Chapter 5 mission, so the exact chapter/finale sequence remains unconfirmed.

missable.note: PowerPyx labels the trophy automatic and unmissable, although its stated mission placement is internally inconsistent.

7.summary: Finish the final main mission for the story-ending trophy. The launch roadmap gives inconsistent chapter information, so the final mission’s precise placement is unconfirmed.
prerequisites: Reach the final main mission

steps.text: Keep chapter-boundary manual saves as the story advances. PowerPyx reports no mission replay and recommends using ten slots for chapter starts and ends.
Finish the main story’s final mission, as required by the official trophy description.

PowerPyx calls the trigger Starting From Zero in Chapter 4, also assigns that mission to Chapter 4 completion, and separately describes Chapter 5. Treat the exact finale timing as unconfirmed while following the story to its end.

missable.note: The roadmap calls this an automatic story unlock. Its contradictory finale placement does not establish a missable condition.

8.summary: Complete Breakfast Run during Chapter 2. PowerPyx describes the trophy as a guaranteed main-story unlock.
prerequisites: Reach Breakfast Run in the Chapter 2 main story

steps.text: Retain your Chapter 2 start save if you want a way back to the chapter. The roadmap recommends manual chapter saves because missions cannot be replayed.
Follow the main missions through Breakfast Run. Completing it awards Trust automatically.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly calls Breakfast Run an automatic, unmissable story trophy.

9.summary: Finish The Cartel Heist during Chapter 3. This trophy follows that main mission automatically.
prerequisites: Reach The Cartel Heist in the Chapter 3 main story

steps.text: Keep your Chapter 3 boundary saves, following PowerPyx’s recommendation for retaining return points without mission replay.
Complete the main mission The Cartel Heist. PowerPyx lists its completion as the automatic trigger for Break the Bank.

missable.note: The source identifies this named mission trophy as automatic and unmissable.

10.summary: Complete Child’s Play during Chapter 4. The main story supplies this trophy automatically.
prerequisites: Reach Child’s Play in the Chapter 4 main story

steps.text: Retain a Chapter 4 start save as recommended in the roadmap. There is no mission replay if you later want to revisit this part of the story.
Play through Child’s Play as part of the Chapter 4 main missions. PowerPyx says Family Matters unlocks automatically.

missable.note: PowerPyx marks this trophy as an automatic story event that cannot be missed.

11.summary: Finish Headliners in Chapter 4. PowerPyx reports an automatic trophy tied to that main mission.
prerequisites: Reach Headliners in the Chapter 4 main story

steps.text: Keep the Chapter 4 manual saves recommended by the roadmap, since there is no mission replay feature.
Continue the main story and complete Headliners. That mission awards DWNFALL automatically according to PowerPyx.

missable.note: The per-trophy paragraph explicitly describes an automatic, unmissable story unlock.

12.summary: Complete VCIA Takedown during Chapter 4. This is the named main-mission milestone for Hi-Jacked.
prerequisites: Reach VCIA Takedown in the Chapter 4 main story

steps.text: Retain your Chapter 4 boundary saves, following the roadmap’s advice for a story with no mission replay.
Finish the main mission VCIA Takedown. PowerPyx lists this mission as an automatic trophy trigger.

missable.note: PowerPyx calls the mission trophy automatic and unmissable.

13.summary: Finish Operation Savage Glory in the main story. PowerPyx puts this mission in Chapter 5, although its separate finale entries have conflicting chapter information.
prerequisites: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the main story

steps.text: Keep manual saves at chapter boundaries. PowerPyx recommends this because the game has no mission replay option.
Complete Operation Savage Glory when the main story reaches it. PowerPyx’s Snow Storm paragraph places this automatic unlock in Chapter 5, while its finale chronology remains inconsistent.

missable.note: PowerPyx identifies this mission trophy as automatic and unmissable.

14.summary: Fill the post-story completion checklist, which uses selected targets across story tasks, exploration, activities and discovery. Several targets exceed the standalone trophy requirements, so plan cleanup around the checklist totals.
14.when: Build progress during the story, inspect the checklist after the finale
prerequisites: Finish the story to reveal Progress > Stats > 100% Completion

steps.text: During the story, do optional tasks, scan base-model vehicles and study animals with binoculars. After the finale, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to review the totals already credited.

Finish 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, all 7 payday-loan jobs, 34 of 35 Smash ’N’ Grabs and 50 different stick-ups. Fence $100,000 each of narcotics and jewelry, $250,000 in marked bills and $200,000 in vehicles, and hit all 8 vaults.

For bank completion, loot both the drawer and safe in each small bank, plus the vault in each large bank. Credit Check in Chapter 3 unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, and That’s Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 opens large-vault jobs.

Clear 5 Kenton sets and all 33 underwater discoveries. Collect 15 card sets, scan 100 WAiNK locations, find 30 publications/book swaps, complete 15 meditations, destroy 100 cocaine flamingos, finish both unique playlists and discover 70 styles.

Win 30 unique races, earn 10 race-challenge golds and all 42 shooting-range golds, play all 4 video games, defeat 5 pool opponents, play 2 mini-golf locations and score at 90 distinct basketball hoops. Complete all 42 drone trials, 300 stunts, 70 challenges and Bret’s 15 target decks.

Finish discovery by scanning 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, acquiring 50 standard-issue weapons and studying 100 animals. The checklist’s discovery section excludes standout vehicles from the 200-model target, and includes animal breeds, birds and fish among valid study subjects.

missable.note: The checklist explicitly says every required target remains available after the story. Its 15-of-18 meditation target allows the Chapter 1-only session to be skipped.

14.effort: PowerPyx budgets roughly 100 hours for checklist cleanup after its 60–80-hour story stage.

15.summary: Complete 250 distinct stunts using any mix of the four stunt categories. The completion checklist later needs 300, so this is a milestone on the same route.
15.when: Exploration during the story or post-story cleanup

steps.text: Find stunt sites under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots. Found and completed sites retain their names on the map, allowing you to identify unfinished ones.
Mix stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps until 250 are complete. PowerPyx lists 397 total, with 130, 202, 40 and 25 in those respective categories.
Use under-bridge flights to build the total efficiently. Completing a stunt once counts, and the extra challenges displayed on its map icon are optional for this trophy.
Check Progress > Activities > Stunts and select a category for regional totals. The post-story checklist requires 300 completed stunts.

missable.note: Stunts are a completion-checklist requirement, and PowerPyx says all checklist work remains available in post-story free roam.

16.summary: Record at least one attempt in each of the nine activity types tracked by the trophy. The Activities screen shows which types you have already tried.

steps.text: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities and highlight each activity to inspect its completed count.
Try fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool and basketball. For basketball, score a hoop so that activity registers.
Play a video game, win a car race/race challenge/Top Fun drone race, and perform a stunt to cover the remaining categories.
Use Map > Activities, identified by the blue dumbbell, to find unfinished types. Most activities are introduced through story progress or marked as you uncover the map.

missable.note: PowerPyx places these activities on the route to the other trophies and the post-story-accessible completion checklist.

sources.name: PowerPyx trophy guide, Master of None

17.summary: Earn gold in every shooting-range challenge. The checklist specifies 42 golds, but the launch source’s range and medal breakdowns are internally inconsistent.
17.when: Activity cleanup, during the story or afterward
prerequisites: Buy a $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk at each range you use

steps.text: Visit a shooting range and speak to its store clerk to buy the $5 Waiver Pass. The checklist names Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch as venues.
After buying the pass, use the challenge markers at the range. Each challenge awards medals according to its course time or score, so repeat it until gold is recorded.
Inspect Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges for remaining gold medals and continue across the available challenges. The checklist’s stated target is 42 golds.

Treat the exact venue-by-venue distribution as unconfirmed. The checklist describes two ranges while its linked guide title refers to 12 locations, and its local medal totals conflict with the 42-gold target.

missable.note: All shooting-range golds are part of the completion checklist, which PowerPyx says can be finished after the story.

18.summary: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each site has three trials, with further trials relevant to the larger completion-checklist target.

steps.text: Use Map > Activities > Top Fun Drones to locate races. Their blue icons appear when you approach within about 100 meters/yards.
Win a drone race at each of the 14 locations to satisfy the trophy’s location-based requirement.
For the checklist, beat the par time in each site’s first two trials to unlock the third. Completing that third trial at any time counts toward its 42-trial requirement.
Hold the left stick forward to maintain maximum speed and avoid collisions. Review Progress > Activities > Top Fun Drones to identify remaining trials.

missable.note: Drone trials are included in the checklist, and the checklist states its required activities remain available after the story.

19.summary: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique races. Continuing to 30 unique wins also fulfills the completion-checklist race target.

steps.text: Look for blue race icons as you travel. The checklist says they appear when you approach within about 100 meters/yards, and Map > Activities > Racing filters them.
Win races at 20 different events. The trophy description requires different races, so use the race-group totals to plan new wins.
Open Progress > Activities > Racing and highlight each Race Group to review the number of wins credited.
Keep going until 30 of the 40 unique races are won if pursuing A Long Road. Race-challenge gold medals have a separate checklist target.

missable.note: Unique race wins contribute to the checklist, whose requirements remain available in post-story free roam.

sources.name: PowerPyx trophy guide, Earn Cash, Not Kudos

20.summary: Follow Cal’s fishing questline and beat him in a challenge. His invitation arrives by text after meeting him in the Chapter 1 story.
20.when: After Chapter 1’s Feng Shui, once Cal texts
prerequisites: Complete Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal)
Receive Cal’s fishing invitation text

steps.text: Advance past Feng Shui (Meet Cal) in Chapter 1. PowerPyx says Cal sends the invitation later, without specifying a fixed delay.
Read Cal’s text and travel to the fishing location marked with a purple map icon.
Follow his fishing questline and win a challenge against him. The launch paragraph supplies no verified bait choice, fishing spot name or catch quota.

missable.note: The roadmap identifies only the Chapter 1 meditation as potentially missable and provides post-story cleanup for remaining trophies.

sources.name: PowerPyx trophy guide, Baited My Tackle

21.summary: Finish every level of one playable video game. Choose whichever of the four games you prefer, since the trophy accepts any completed game.
21.when: Available in Chapter 1, or after home games return later in the story

steps.text: Interact with the controllers at your home TV to choose Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind. PowerPyx says these can be started in Chapter 1.
Alternatively, play Bang For Your Buck at a world arcade machine. Complete all levels of your chosen game and reach its ending.
Focus on reaching the game’s end. PowerPyx says the trophy requires finishing its levels and leaves its additional challenges optional.

If home controllers are unavailable during Chapter 2, return from Chapter 3 onward or after the story. Progress > Activities > Games tracks games played, and the 100% checklist separately asks you to start all four.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly says home games become available again and remain playable after the story.

22.summary: Finish Andy’s five-part optional quest sequence as Lucia. Her Chapter 3 call leads to an address in Belville and eventually Puff Puff Pass.
22.when: Chapter 3 onward, as Lucia, or post-story cleanup
prerequisites: Reach Chapter 3
Play as Lucia to receive Andy’s call and address text

steps.text: Play as Lucia during Chapter 3 until Andy calls, then read the address she texts. It marks her questline at her home in Belville.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain, including its three parts, then Pay the Cellerica Fee.
Continue with Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), followed by Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van).
Finish Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse) to receive the trophy. PowerPyx separately warns that Andy’s line does not contribute to the eight-stranger-strands trophy.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly states all of Andy’s quests remain available after the story.

23.summary: Recover and return the treasures from Kenton’s seven shipwrecks. His questline temporarily pauses after Chapter 1, then becomes available again.
23.when: Start after Island Dreams in Chapter 1, continue in Chapters 2–3 or after the story
prerequisites: Complete Chapter 1 main mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)
Receive Kenton’s follow-up call

steps.text: After Island Dreams, wait for Kenton’s call and visit the green KR marker in Key Lento to start his treasure-diving work.
Dive at the purple treasure-chest markers he supplies. Use the metal detector to locate and dig up buried treasure on the seabed, then return the finds to Kenton.
After handing in a set, follow his calls back to the shop and the new wreck locations. Continue until all seven shipwrecks in his questline are cleared.
If Kenton disappears after Chapter 1, continue as Jason into Chapters 2–3. PowerPyx says calling Brian later in Chapter 2 can bring Kenton’s return text sooner.

Review Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton’s Treasures. For A Long Road, also review the separate 33 Underwater Discoveries counter under Collections > Exploration.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly explains the temporary disappearance and confirms the entire questline remains available after the story.

24.summary: Complete Billy’s five optional missions, ending with Hometown Heroes. His strand begins at Thrillbilly Mudclub after the Chapter 2 partner unlock.
24.when: After Chapter 2’s Coffee Break, or post-story cleanup
prerequisites: Complete Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break

steps.text: After Coffee Break, find Billy’s automatically marked quest at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Start with Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), then complete Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (Join Billy on a Job).
Continue with Mall Rats (Join Billy on a Job), followed by The Impaler (Steal the Impaler).
Complete Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job) for the trophy. Billy’s strand is separately excluded from the eight-stranger-strands counter in PowerPyx’s guide.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly confirms that all of Billy’s quests remain available after the story.

25.summary: Complete eight qualifying stranger mission strands. The launch guide confirms only four qualifying strands, so the full set of eight remains unconfirmed.
25.when: Post-story stranger cleanup, with earlier progress also useful

steps.text: Check this trophy’s tracker in the trophy list to see how many qualifying strands have registered. PowerPyx excludes Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie from this counter.
Finish Kirk’s three listed missions, Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies and Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove. PowerPyx confirms his strand counts.
Complete Kyle’s Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle and Buddy? (Check on Kyle). Complete Yago’s Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago and Brother to Brother.
Complete Pilot Pete’s Recover Pete’s Plane, Backseat Pilot, deliveries to Southpoint Airfield and Avery Allen & Co., and the listed Deliver Packages follow-up.

Use the trophy tracker to confirm further qualifying strands until eight register. The supplied launch guide identifies four by name and says more remain to be discovered, so the remaining strand identities and starting locations are unconfirmed.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly says the open-world strangers remain available after the story. Its incomplete list leaves the full eight-strand route unconfirmed.

26.summary: Finish Randy’s Wish List by supplying all 16 requested sports cars. The Chapter 3 story delivery introduces both Randy and the Key Cloner.
26.when: Chapter 3 onward, or post-story vehicle cleanup
prerequisites: Complete Chapter 3 main mission Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)
Obtain the Key Cloner during that mission

steps.text: Complete the story delivery of the Granforma Zorrusso to Randy. It introduces the Key Cloner and supplies the first of the 16 cars on his list.
Open Map > Robberies > Randy’s Wish List to review his marked targets. Scan sports cars with WAiNK or enter them to receive a delivery popup when Randy wants that model.

Look around hotels and roads at Vice Beach and Ocean Beach in eastern Vice City. Deliver requested cars to the green RK garage marker in western Vice City, preserving their condition for better payment.

Alongside the Zorrusso, supply Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. Clearing marked targets prompts Randy to mark more.
Use these deliveries toward the checklist’s $200,000 in fenced vehicles. Its guide reports around $35,000 or more for Randy’s sports cars in perfect condition.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly states Randy’s Wish List can be finished after the story.

sources.name: PowerPyx trophy guide, Randy’s Wish List

27.summary: Destroy Tyrone’s synthetic-drug labs as Jason, then complete his final mission Spin On This. His lab work unlocks after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
27.when: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, as Jason
prerequisites: Complete Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty
Play as Jason for Tyrone’s questline

steps.text: Switch to Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty and look for the purple Synthetic Lab markers in Vice City. PowerPyx identifies this questline as Jason-exclusive.
Destroy labs marked for Take Out Kitty Litter. The launch guide says enough lab completions unlock the follow-up, but gives no confirmed numeric threshold.
Complete Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) when Tyrone offers it. This second listed quest awards the trophy.
Count the synthetic-lab tasks toward the completion checklist’s 100 optional tasks. The checklist specifically includes Tyrone’s individual labs among qualifying tasks.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly says Tyrone’s lab work and final quest remain available after the story.

28.summary: Visit all ten meditation locations, using both characters at the shared spots to build the 18-session total. Preserve the Chapter 1 house session because its necessity for the trophy is still unconfirmed.
28.when: Protect the Chapter 1 session, then continue after Chapter 2’s Coffee Break
prerequisites: Complete Coffee Break in Chapter 2 to bring both characters together for later sessions
Complete the other meditations to reveal the final Ascent Mountain spot

steps.text: Keep a Chapter 1 save. After Down to Earth, check Jason’s kitchen in the morning and speak to Lucia. When she heads to the balcony to meditate, follow and accept the optional invitation. PowerPyx says the precise morning can vary and this session disappears after Chapter 1.

After Coffee Break, bring Jason and Lucia to the shared spots and meditate with each. Use Map > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida and Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations to review locations and sessions.

Visit Smooth Sand on the small sandbar west of Capri in Mariana County. In Kelly County, visit the dock beside Buckskin Swamp’s lookout tower, the Emerald River bank at Camp Moonflower and the railway/highway crossing in Manifest Canyon.

In Lummox County, visit the ruined paper mill’s waterwheel south of Moreau, the tower overlooking the mine in Mount Kalaga National Park and the viewpoint northwest of Tallaloko over the east-flowing waterfall.

Visit Seaside on the rocky outcrop east of Waning Sands in Leonard County. Once the other meditations are complete, follow the purple-icon notification to Ascent Mountain’s stone circle on Mount Kalaga’s peak.

Distinguish the trophy’s all-spots target from A Long Road’s 15-of-18 session target. The specialist guide counts one house session, two per shared spot and one final mountain session, and leaves the house session’s trophy necessity unconfirmed.

missable.note: The Jason-house meditation is Chapter 1-only. PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it but has not established whether that session is required. Its absence still leaves enough sessions for the 100% checklist.

29.summary: Hunt a unique animal requested by Bret Vogel and bring it to him as Jason. The launch guide explains the hunting route but leaves the exact trophy-triggering animal unconfirmed.
29.when: After Chapter 2’s Coffee Break, as Jason, or after the story
prerequisites: Complete Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break
Receive Bret Vogel’s text as Jason
Meet Bret in Veteran Hunted

steps.text: Play as Jason after Coffee Break until Bret’s text marks Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County. PowerPyx says Lucia cannot receive this invitation.
Complete Veteran Hunted to receive Bret’s Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle and reveal purple hunting markers. The rifle can later be retrieved from an Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
Hunt the animals Bret requests and return them to him as Jason. A clean head or heart shot preserves condition and improves payment, according to the checklist’s hunting instructions.
Track requests under Map > Activities > Target Deck, or Progress > Contacts > Bret Vogel after meeting him. The checklist requires all 15 target decks.
Continue Bret’s unique-animal work while checking the trophy. PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers Fair Game, so there is no sourced single-target shortcut.

missable.note: PowerPyx explicitly confirms Bret’s questline remains available after the story. The specific triggering animal is still unconfirmed.

sources.name: PowerPyx trophy guide, Bret & Fair Game

30.summary: Collect every unique card in three sets. The specialist page lists 18 sets and 480 unique cards, with different set sizes and color variants affecting completion.
30.when: Collect during exploration, finish sets in post-story cleanup

steps.text: Look on indoor surfaces and walls, and inspect yellow phone boxes and toolboxes outdoors for cards. The specialist guide says cards are found in the world and gives no purchase-farming method.
Target three complete sets. Backyard Wrestling has 12 cards and Delights Dancers has 18, while many sports sets have 24 and the larger comic/music sets have 36.
Check Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards to identify missing entries and close out sets.

Collect missing color variants because they count as distinct cards. Duplicate copies can be sold, but add no new set progress. Selling cards at pawn shops preserves the collection credit already earned.
Continue to 15 completed sets if pursuing A Long Road. The specialist page distinguishes its 15-set requirement from this trophy’s three-set target.

missable.note: Card sets are a completion-checklist requirement and PowerPyx says that checklist remains fully achievable after the story. Selling collected cards preserves credit.

31.summary: Use WAiNK to scan 100 environmental locations. Landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags are among the supported scan categories.
31.when: Exploration throughout the story or afterward

steps.text: Explore on foot and watch for the popup indicating a nearby scannable location. The checklist says this notification appears while walking.
Open the phone’s WAiNK scanner and scan the environmental object. Landmarks and sculptures are examples given by the checklist.
Build toward 100 locations across the categories. The trophy guide lists 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags, with more than 100 scan opportunities overall.
Review Progress > Collections > Waink Locations to monitor credited scans. The completion checklist uses the same 100-location target.

missable.note: The 100-location target is part of the checklist, whose required content remains available after the story.

32.summary: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Leave targeted cleanup until other activities have already filled many requirements naturally.

steps.text: Open Progress > Challenges. The checklist describes eight categories with ten challenges each and says they are available from the start.
Highlight individual challenges and look for the Completed checkmark in the lower-right corner to identify progress already earned.
Finish other trophy and checklist activities first, then choose the quickest remaining challenges until 50 are complete.
For A Long Road, continue to 70 completed challenges. That target permits you to leave ten of the 80 unfinished.

missable.note: Challenges are a checklist target, and PowerPyx says all checklist requirements remain available after the story.

sources.name: PowerPyx trophy guide, One Last Thing

33.summary: Escape both a four-star pursuit and the remaining heat zone while your partner is with you. Large-vault jobs naturally create the required wanted level.
33.when: After Chapter 2’s Coffee Break, convenient during Chapter 4 vault jobs
prerequisites: Complete Coffee Break to unlock partnered free roam

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner so Jason and Lucia are together before starting the pursuit.
Reach four wanted stars. A large-vault robbery is a sourced way to trigger that level after the Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is….
Use a fast sports motorcycle to cut through traffic. PowerPyx recommends the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police have trouble following and helicopters lose sight of you.
Continue beyond the red heat zone after clearing the flashing police search area. PowerPyx says the trophy waits until the remaining red heat radius has been escaped.

missable.note: The roadmap provides repeatable free-roam pursuits and links the unlock to large-vault jobs required for the post-story checklist.

34.summary: Loot three shops consecutively with your partner while maintaining an active wanted level. PowerPyx reports a delayed unlock and suggests a fourth shop if the first robbery began before police arrived.
34.when: After Coffee Break, with a suggested route unlocked in Chapter 3
prerequisites: Complete Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break
For the suggested jewelry-store route, complete Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs

steps.text: Call your partner before starting. Equip body armor and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, and bring Zombix or Adrenaline for healing as recommended by PowerPyx.
Use three jewelry stores in northern Vice City once Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs unlocks them, or choose other green robbery targets.
Loot items at the first shop and wait for the active police pursuit before moving on. Maintain the flashing red/blue wanted state across the next robberies.
Loot several items in each shop and clear backroom safes where possible. PowerPyx recommends sticky bombs for the safes to help ensure each store counts.

Allow about half a minute after leaving the third shop for the trophy. If it has not registered, continue to a fourth while preserving the pursuit, particularly if police arrived after you left the first store.

missable.note: The roadmap identifies only the early meditation as potentially missable, and this method uses free-roam robberies available for cleanup.

35.summary: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK. Scanning alone earns discovery credit, and the checklist’s 200-base-model target takes you beyond this trophy.
35.when: Start in Chapter 1 and scan while traveling
prerequisites: WAiNK scanner, automatically unlocked during Chapter 1

steps.text: Once the scanner unlocks in Chapter 1, open WAiNK and scan new vehicle models on busy roads. PowerPyx says scanning is enough to discover them.
Vary your region to find more models. The checklist suggests Ocean Beach hotels for supercars, Port Gellhorn for vans and trucks, and Key Lento for basic vehicles.
Include boats and aircraft when building discovery progress. The roadmap specifically recommends scanning them alongside road vehicles.
Check Progress > Vehicles for discovery progress. For A Long Road, reach 200 of the 277 base models, whose checklist count excludes standout vehicles.

missable.note: The larger base-model discovery target is part of the checklist, whose requirements remain available after the story.

36.summary: Defeat five enemies within one activation of Combat Focus. A group of criminals at an illegal gang operation gives you a supported place to attempt it.
36.when: Later combat cleanup, once Focus has improved

steps.text: Check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > your character > Focus, shown by a purple eye. Shooting-range challenges, golf, pool and fishing raise Focus, and PowerPyx reports four levels.
Restore Focus with food, drinks, washing your face or a shower, and use Adrenaline to extend its duration. Bring body armor and an accurate automatic rifle such as the Duke 556.
Find criminals at an illegal gang operation and line up at least five enemies before activating Focus. The source reports that police, soldiers and civilians appear unreliable for this trophy.
